page.overview:
Who is Myrgot?

Myrgot was a mounted Zerrikanian warrior.

Around the beginning of the s, Myrgot arrived in Caingorn with Borch Three Jackdaws and two fellow Zerrikanians, Téa and Véa. There, shortly before summoning people for a dragon-hunting expedition, King Niedamir organized a jousting tournament in which Myrgot took on the pious knight Eyck of Denesle.

After losing, Myrgot realized he put his country to shame and returned to Zerrikania.
